page.overview:
Who is Hakubi Shin?

During his time as a Konoha-nin, Hakubi gained recognition as a "special" ninja with decent skills. However, he had the bad habit of stealing while on missions, for which reason he was expelled from the village. Afterwards, he started taking contract work from whoever would hire him. At some point, he heard that Kakashi Hatake lost his Sharingan.

Although a decent ninja, Hakubi was a kleptomaniac, stealing items during missions, which eventually led him to be banished from his home village. He remained grudgeful of Konoha for kicking him out, and tried to kill the Sixth Hokage as what he deems to be the perfect way for revenge. His tendency of thievery made him ruthless, as he roughed up a girl to take a blue gem she tried to trade for some drinking water.

Hakubi's specialty is coating shuriken with lightning chakra, making them undetectable once thrown. He can furthermore control the shuriken remotely, directing them to his target's blindspots in order to kill them without them ever noticing his presence. Hakubi also claims to be able to perform the Lightning Cutter, something Kakashi notes to be incorrect.

Hakubi is one of fifty ninja hired by the Prime Minister of the Land of Redaku to carry out an invasion of the Land of Fire. While he's in Redaku's capital city preparing for the invasion, he comes across a young girl trying to trade a valuable blue gem for some drinkable water. Hakubi roughs her up and steals the blue gem.
